business_model.claim: Lindblad sells marine expedition cruises and land-based adventure travel experiences to guests, operating under multiple brands including Lindblad Expeditions, Natural Habitat, Off the Beaten Path, DuVine, Classic Journeys, and Thomson Group.
quotes: Lindblad has been providing marine expedition adventures and active travel experiences globally to its guests since 1979.

Our brands include Lindblad Expeditions, Natural Habitat, Inc. ("Natural Habitat"), Off the Beaten Path, LLC ("Off the Beaten Path"), DuVine Cycling + Adventure Company ("DuVine"), Classic Journeys, LLC ("Classic Journeys"), and Thomson Group, consisting of Wineland-Thomson Adventures, LLC ("Thomson Safaris"), Nature Discovery Ltd ("Nature Discovery"), Thomson Safaris Ltd ("Thomson Safaris Tanzania"), and Ngorongoro Safari Lodge Ltd ("Gibb's Farm").

business_model.claim: The primary customer base is affluent individuals in the U.S. aged 50 or older, though offerings also appeal to families and a wide range of travelers.
quotes: Our offerings appeal to a wide range of travelers, both individuals and families, with affluent individuals in the U.S. aged 50 years or older representing our largest demographic category.

business_model.claim: The company reports two segments: the Lindblad segment (ship-based expedition cruising) and the Land Experiences segment (land-based adventure brands).
quotes: We operate two segments consisting of (i) the Lindblad segment, which consists of the operations of our Lindblad brand, and (ii) the Land Experiences segment, consisting of our Natural Habitat, Off the Beaten Path, DuVine, Classic Journeys brands and the Thomson Group.

business_model.claim: The Lindblad segment operates 12 owned expedition vessels and 10 seasonal chartered ships serving over 40 destinations on six continents.
quotes: We currently operate a fleet of 12 owned expedition vessels, along with 10 seasonal chartered ships (with several other vessels contracted for future expeditions), to provide our signature marine-based adventures to over 40 destinations on six continents

business_model.claim: Tour revenues consist of guest ticket revenues and other tour revenues from pre/post-expedition excursions, hotel accommodations, air transportation, onboard goods and services, trip insurance, and cancellation fees.
quotes: guest ticket revenues recognized from the sale of guest tickets; and

other tour revenues from the sale of pre- or post-expedition excursions, hotel accommodations and land-based expeditions; air transportation to and from the ships, goods and services rendered onboard that are not included in guest ticket prices, trip insurance and cancellation fees.

business_model.claim: In Q2 2026, Lindblad segment tour revenues grew 16% to $129.2 million, driven by a 4% increase in net yield per available guest night to $1,294 and an occupancy increase to 91% from 86%.
quotes: Lindblad segment tour revenues of $129.2 million increased $18.2 million, or 16%, compared to the second quarter a year ago primarily due to a 4% increase in net yield per available guest night to $1,294 driven by an increase in occupancy to 91% from 86% in the second quarter a year ago.

business_model.claim: For the six months ended June 30, 2026, total tour revenues were $407,260 (table in thousands), up 17% from $347,666 (table in thousands) in the prior-year period.

Full-year 2025 tour revenues were $771.0 million, up 20% from $644.7 million in 2024, with $96.8 million of the increase from a 13% rise in guest nights sold and $29.5 million from increased pricing and itinerary mix changes.
quotes: Tour revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased $126.3 million, or 20%, to $771.0 million, compared to $644.7 million for the year ended December 31, 2024. Of the $126.3 million increase, $96.8 million was due to a 13% increase in guest nights sold and a 16% increase in guests traveled, and $29.5 million was due to increased pricing and changes in the mix of itineraries and trips.

business_model.claim: Cost of tours includes direct costs of excursions, air and transportation, payroll for shipboard and expedition personnel, food costs for guests and crew, fuel costs, and other tour expenses such as port costs, drydock, ship insurance, and charter hire costs.
quotes: payroll costs and related expenses for shipboard and expedition personnel;
food costs for guests and crew, including complimentary food and beverage amenities for guests;
fuel costs and related costs of delivery, storage and safe disposal of waste;
other tour expenses, such as land costs, port costs, repairs and maintenance, equipment expense, drydock, ship insurance, charter hire costs and credit card fees.

business_model.claim: Selling and marketing expenses are driven primarily by royalties under the National Geographic agreement, commissions, and marketing spend, and increased 32% to $114.7 million in FY2025.
quotes: Selling and marketing expenses for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased $27.7 million, or 32%, to $114.7 million, compared to $87.0 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, primarily due to higher royalties associated with the National Geographic agreement and increased revenues driving higher commissions expense and increased marketing spend to support future growth.

business_model.claim: The company maintains a premium pricing strategy, achieving high net yields and occupancy rates rather than discounting like mass-market cruise lines.
quotes: The quality of our offerings has enabled us to achieve and maintain premium pricing in the market instead of pursuing the type of discounting offered by most cruise lines that are focused on the broader market. Our product offering, value proposition and differentiated pricing approach have enabled us to historically achieve high net yields and occupancy rates.

(the "Company") entered into an Agreement (the "Purchase Agreement") for the Sale and Purchase of a Majority Interest in White Desert Ltd, PNR Airways Ltd and Echo Charlie Ltd (collectively, the "Purchased Companies"), pioneering Antarctic expeditions and providing aviation based experiential travel for modern-day explorers.
